text:
mina: deploybot started a canary for `quant-vec-swap-v1.4+abi12` in ca-central-1 during the quiet window. seeing intermittent kernel-level signature mismatch and some tail jitter. thinking temporary pin while we test a small instruction-variant shim.

deploybot: ACTION: rollout initiated for bundle quant-vec-swap-v1.4+abi12 in ca-central-1. Canary slice: 10 hosts. (run `deploybot status 1799999998`)

sre-bot: quick telemetry: p95 +10% on canary hosts, error-rate 0.6% vs baseline 0.15%. logs show signature mismatches on matmul paths on 3 hosts. link: https://telemetry.internal/redwood/canary/1799999998

ash: paste the mismatch snippet? could be a codegen variant selecting unsupported isa sequence for some drivers.

mina: host tail:
```
[2026-05-30T01:02:03Z] kernel: isa_sig_mismatch: expected=AVX2_FMA found=AVX2
[2026-05-30T01:02:04Z] runtime: fallback_kernel selected slower_variant
[2026-05-30T01:02:05Z] runtime: tail_latency p95=210ms model=quant-vec-swap-v1.4
```

ops_rui: mismatch suggests codegen emitted AVX2_FMA but host lacks fused-mul-add, so runtime falls back. Customer-visible but not OOM. Options: 1) pause and pin to v1.3 2) push small hotpatch that forces safe isa path (shim) and roll narrow canary 3) continue with throttle. Thoughts?

ash: I can build a shim quickly that disables FMA probe at runtime (forces safe_variant). It should be low-risk and quick to test in a 3-host narrow canary.

mina: prefer shim attempt before region rollback. Proposal: pin TTL=90m, pause expansion, deploy narrow canary with shim to 3 hosts at 5% traffic. If shim reduces errors and p95 back within +3% -> promote; else rollback to v1.3.

patch-bot: NOTE: hotpatch bundle `quant-vec-swap-v1.4-shim-isa` created by ash. Tag: hotpatch-1799999998. Ready for narrow canary.

deploybot: UPDATE: rollout paused in ca-central-1; pin TTL set to 90m by mina. Ready to deploy narrow canary for hotpatch.

ops_rui: executing narrow canary now. will monitor nvml and telemetry. rollback criteria: errors >0.5% sustained 5m or p95 >+8% sustained 5m -> rollback to v1.3.

sre-bot: ticket RED-4999 opened: "ca-central canary: quant-vec-swap-v1.4 isa signature mismatch; hotpatch in-flight". attaching traces and will update with narrow canary results.

mina: thanks. ash, once narrow canary stable, we'll update release notes and decide next steps. :thumbsup:
